svg.title: Voron 2.4r2 — gantry racking and de-racking

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Racking, and how to measure it

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A racked gantry has one side of the X extrusion further forward than the other. You de-rack by pushing the X extrusion fully back against both drives and tightening the X/Y joints there.

svg.text: The four-point gap measurement — bench check, not in the official text

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: With the caliper's depth rod, measure the horizontal gap between each Y extrusion and the frame upright beside

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it, at front-left, rear-left, front-right and rear-right. Front and rear on the SAME side must agree within 0.5

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mm — a difference is the gantry skewed in the frame. Left and right must agree within 1 mm — a difference is the

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gantry off-centre. Then stand a machinist square on the front frame extrusion at each front corner, blade

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: against the Y extrusion: no light under the blade. Write the numbers down; you repeat this three times.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Do all of this on a level surface with the A/B motors disabled and both A/B belts fully slack, and keep a hand on the gantry while the lower Z joints are off. Re-tension both belts to 110 Hz afterwards.
